question: How, in our view, does practice stationed in the all-self remove the other?
premises: breath intellect body and the rest are clearly all-self
what it removes is otherness itself
inference: Abiding in the all-self dissolves otherness by practice, not by argument.
uncertainties: sarvatmakatva scope (all selves or the all-self) kept per gloss
plain_english: Or, in our view, breath intellect body and the rest are clearly all-self — practice stationed there is removal of the other.
